integrity: The proof identifies maximal scalar twin classes, reconstructs the projective orthogonal polarity quotient from neighborhoods, derives its full semilinear orthogonal automorphism group, and proves matching sharp twin lower bounds for determining number and metric dimension. The packaged checker independently reconstructs quotient and full vector graphs in two prime fields, enumerates quotient automorphisms, verifies twin classes, diameter, and a canonical resolving basis.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an odd finite field \(\mathbb F_q\).
Only the three-dimensional total dot-product graph \(TD(\mathbb F_q,3)\) is covered.
Characteristic two requires a separate polarity analysis.
The exhaustive checker samples the prime fields \(\mathbb F_3\) and \(\mathbb F_5\); the arbitrary prime-power statement is proved projectively.
title: Automorphisms and metric bases of three-dimensional finite-field dot-product graphs
